reasoning.chart: For: bad-tape day bought on volume; up from 5.88 on 11-05, just above the 52-week low of 5.69. Against: 50-day (9.73) under the 200-day (10.66) and both falling, -19% in 20 days, loose base (1.20), and it is already +25% in three sessions.

reasoning.case_against: The buyback is discretionary with no timetable or funding named, the $1.5B at-the-market share programme stays open, and Long Ridge may need financing inside the window. About 20,400 BTC (roughly half of market value) is still held and management says it will keep selling. The one earlier report it rose on (2-27, +5.8%) gave the gain back within five sessions, and March's convertible buyback pop reversed in two. No AI hosting lease is signed and it 'could slip into next year'. It fell 14% in the 11-05 AI sell-off, which IBIT does not hedge. Beta to IBIT is 1.38, so equal dollars stay net long bitcoin. It didn't win because the news is one day old, specific, large against the company's size, and the price went up on it against both bitcoin and the market; a 3, not more.

proposals.wrong_if: MARA announces a share sale, at-the-market use or a new convertible (for Long Ridge or otherwise), or says the buyback waits on other uses of cash; or it gives back the whole 11-10 gain against IBIT (closes under 6.64 with bitcoin flat or up) on no news.
proposals.hedge_why: Correlation 0.60, beta 1.38. Bitcoin is still about half of market value and drives mining revenue, and it is the risk I don't want; SMH (0.64) would hedge the AI-hosting side instead and adds Nvidia, which the book is already short.
